sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1991
ACT VII OF 1991
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HISTORICAL MOSQUES AND SHRINES FUND CESS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to
amend the West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance,
1960
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th March, 1991]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/91/5157, dated
27-3-1991.---The North-West Frontier Province Historical Mosques and Shrines
Fund Cess (Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of the North-West Frontier Province on the 17th March, 1991 and assented to by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 25th March, 1991, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called. the
North-West Frontier Province Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess
(Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 1st October, 1989.

2. Amendment of section 3 of W.P. Ord. V of 1960.--In the West
Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960 (W.P.
Ordinance V of 1960), in section 3,--

subsection (3), for the words "five paisa" the words "eight
paisa" shall be substituted, and
(b) subsection
